outgoing.name: Bristol
outgoing.excerpt: In 1847, the Fry's chocolate factory, located in Bristol, England, moulded the first ever chocolate bar suitable for widespread consumption.

outgoing.name: Chocolate
outgoing.excerpt: Fry & Sons, Ltd. was a chocolate company owned by Joseph Storrs Fry and his family.

outgoing.name: World War I
outgoing.excerpt: Near the start of World War I the company was the largest employer in Bristol.
